top_news.title: Whispering Wisely: Smart Subset Selection for ASR Fine-Tuning
top_news.dek: Researchers propose an embedding-based subset selection method to reduce the computational cost of fine-tuning ASR models like Whisper.
top_news.brief: Fine-tuning ASR models on large datasets is resource-intensive. This approach uses Whisper's pretrained encoder to map audio samples into an embedding space, then applies a greedy k-center algorithm to select a diverse, representative subset of data for training.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing audio samples mapped to an embedding space with selected representative clusters.

top_news.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
top_news.dek: OpenAI is experimenting with new academic release strategies for AI-generated scientific discoveries in math, physics, and computer science.
top_news.brief: OpenAI is releasing raw research data on the Kakeya conjecture, the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics. They are collaborating with academic 'shepherds' to organize expert review and verification, treating AI outputs as raw data rather than finished papers.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract representation of scientific research collaboration between AI and academic experts.

top_news.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
top_news.dek: Cloudflare remediated a vulnerability in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model that caused cross-request KV cache exposure.
top_news.brief: Between August 27 and September 9, 2026, 155 responses from the GLM-5.3 model contained data from previous user requests. Cloudflare confirmed the issue was isolated to this specific model and has since implemented a fix.
top_news.image_alt: Security vulnerability remediation concept showing isolated data streams.

top_news.title: Developers Reporting Double-Digit Weekly Time Savings From AI Fell From 68% to 26%
top_news.dek: Atlassian's 2026 report shows a sharp decline in developers reporting significant weekly time savings from AI tools.
top_news.brief: The percentage of developers saving ten or more hours per week with AI dropped from 68% to 26% year-over-year. Only 28% of developers report reduced friction, with many engineering leaders noting that managing and correcting AI-generated output now consumes significant time.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing the year-over-year decline in developer productivity gains from AI.

top_news.title: [AINews] Anthropic files for $2T IPO in 2 weeks: 1400% growth rate, 48% of revenue through cloud partners, 85% margin, $1B op profit in Q2, $134B cash in bank and $10B lifetime burn
top_news.dek: Anthropic has filed for a $2 trillion IPO, reporting high growth, strong margins, and significant operational profitability.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a 1400% growth rate, 85% margins, and $1 billion in Q2 operating profit. The company reports $134 billion in cash reserves against $10 billion in lifetime burn, with nearly half of its revenue generated through cloud partnerships.
top_news.image_alt: Financial growth chart representing Anthropic's IPO metrics.

primary.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
primary.summary: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. But the company also carries roughly $800 billion in long-term compute commitments. primary.title: Article: The Evolution of Agentic Harnesses: From Chains to Graph to Code
primary.summary: Agentic LLM systems have moved from linear prompt chains to graph-based workflows and, more recently, code-executing harnesses. Chains are simple but fragile, graphs add branching, retries, and validation, and code harnesses verify outputs through execution. The article advises validating model outputs and choosing the least complex design that meets reliability, speed, and cost needs. By Karthik Ramgopal
